meta.name: explore-code
meta.description: Rigor Improve implementation leaf skill for auditable candidate implementation in deep learning research repositories. Use when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory work on an isolated branch or worktree to transplant modules, adapt a backbone, add LoRA or adapter layers, replace a head, or stitch together meaningful low-risk migration ideas with rollback-aware records in `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for end-to-end exploration orchestration on top of `current_research`, trusted baseline reproduction, conservative debugging, environment setup, verified contribution claims, or default repository analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让研究代码里的模型改动变成可回溯、可回滚的探索实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你是深度学习研究者,总想在代码里尝试改模型,又怕改坏回不去。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do experimental edits to DL research code and need every change recoverable.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在隔离分支或 worktree 上做探索性代码改动,比如移植模块、适配骨干、加 LoRA/adapter 层或替换 head,并在 explore_outputs/ 里记录改动、回滚方式和为什么它只是候选。
howto.when: 当你明确授权在隔离分支或 worktree 上做探索性改动,而任务是模块移植、骨干适配、LoRA/adapter 插入等低风险改动时触发。

say.text: 在隔离分支上把某个模块移植进这个仓库,记录到 explore_outputs。
say.note: 会生成改动记录和回滚方式

say.text: 给这个骨干网络加上 LoRA 层,并标记为候选改动。
say.note: 会说明为什么它仍算候选

say.text: 把这个模型的 head 换掉,写清怎么回滚。
say.note: 输出可比性报告和状态文件

howto.what_en: Claude makes exploratory code changes on an isolated branch or worktree—transplanting modules, adapting a backbone, adding LoRA/adapter layers or replacing a head—and logs them in explore_outputs/ with rollback steps and candidate status.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly authorize exploratory changes on an isolated branch or worktree: module transplant, backbone adapt, LoRA/adapter insert. Not for baseline work, debugging or broad refactors.

say_en.text: On an isolated branch, transplant module A and log it in explore_outputs.
Add LoRA layers to this backbone and mark the result a candidate.
say_en.note: Records why it's a candidate, not verified.

say_en.text: Replace this model's head; note why it stays a candidate.
